about_the_game:
Ninja Froggy is a fast-paced, semi-open-world endless runner packed with action, absurd obstacles, and a whole lot of amphibian attitude. Playing as Froggy, you’ll dash, slash, and leap your way through chaotic terrain while evading death from all directions.

The longer you survive, the more intense things get: faster enemies, denser traffic, etc. Balance combat, mobility, and resource management as you traverse a dynamically shifting world filled with secrets, distractions, and dangers.
